verdict.rationale: Granola documents a REST API for pulling notes, an MCP server, and a Zapier integration. None of these is a documented, registrable outbound HTTP webhook that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to for events. Zapier automation is a third-party integration layer, and pull-based API access is a different capability, so neither counts as webhook support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
